summary: Backend /api/users/active and /api/users/matches both return 200 cleanly for new (no going_to) and existing (+15550100001) users. matches endpoint correctly returns {matches:[],message:...} for users without going_to and full matches with matched_on populated for the seeded user. However, the /active page CRASHES with an uncaught ReferenceError 'actionDone is not defined' inside UserListItem for BOTH user profiles, so the page never renders active-list, matches-section, empty-active, search input, or any send-request buttons. The Promise.allSettled and (matched_on || []) defensive fixes look correct, but they're masked by this new prop-destructuring bug.
passed: GET /api/users/active returns 200 with 8 users for new authenticated user
GET /api/users/matches returns 200 with empty matches + helpful message for user without going_to
GET /api/users/matches returns 200 with 3 enriched matches (matched_on populated, e.g., ['coffee','road']) for +15550100001
Login flow (send OTP -> verify OTP) works in UI for both new and existing phone numbers

failed.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: actionDone is not defined at UserListItem. UserListItem.js line 19 destructures only { user, subtitle, actionLabel, actionLoading, onAction, secondaryAction, onBlocked } but lines 84/85/87 reference actionDone. ActiveUsers.js passes actionDone={!!sent[u.id]} prop, but it is never read. The runtime error halts rendering of the entire /active route, so neither the empty-state for a brand-new user nor the suggested-matches list for an existing user is visible. The previously claimed fixes (Promise.allSettled, (matched_on||[]).join) cannot be verified because the page crashes before they take effect.
